entities.summary: Kamel Hana Gegeo was an Iraqi Assyrian bodyguard, valet, and food taster of Iraqi President Saddam Hussein. He was murdered by Saddam's son Uday Hussein at a party with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak as a guest.
